title: Olivia Rodrigo Shares a Sad Christmas Song
summary:
Olivia Rodrigo has had a musical Christmas. A few weeks ago, she shared her first Christmas song, 'Take Me Home (4 Christmas).' It is a happy, upbeat song about the thrill of meeting a boyfriend's or girlfriend's family for the holidays. Its video stars Ben Marshall from Saturday Night Live, with Cynthia Nixon playing his mom.

Now she has shared the other side of Christmas: a sad, slow song called 'Miss This Christmas.' It is about missing someone during the holidays. 'Happy Christmas to the lonely / Broken hearts that feel just like me,' she sings. She wrote it with Dan Nigro and Amy Allen. You can hear the official version only on Amazon Music.

Rodrigo first sang the song live this week at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville. She told the crowd it was a 'really sad Christmas song' that no one had heard before.

It has been a big year for her. She earned seven Grammy nominations for her album 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love.' Her Unraveled tour ends on December 20 in Las Vegas, and she will then perform in Los Angeles from January 12 through 29.
why_it_matters: Christmas songs can help kids put their own feelings into words, even sad ones like missing someone they love during the holidays.
